digest.component_or_area: PydanticAIRunner.run() decomposition and provider session lifecycle
propositions: ProviderSession is constructed at runner.py:301 but its try-guard starts at line 474 and finally-close is at 582, leaving lines 301–473 outside protection and leaking an opened httpx.AsyncClient when code raises by design (e.g., _check_tool_capability).

PydanticAIRunner.run() spans 408 lines and is 59% of runner.py; extracting callees satisfies per-file gates while the calling method absorbs new work, so the method bound regrows and file pressure persists.

runner.py at 782 LOC (with cc33 in the stack) exceeds the 700 LOC headroom guard; two sequential extractions (interpret_failure −75 LOC, build_model_settings/build_usage_limits −80 LOC) must land together to clear the guard and each must pass independently at compile-time.
ProviderSession.__enter__ and __exit__ methods exist at providers.py:295–299 but are never used; providers.py:21 documents a with-statement caller that does not exist in the codebase.

Monkeypatch-patched names (_pai_model, _local_proxy_bypass_base_url, ProviderSession, cache_settings_for, and others) referenced via setattr(runner_mod, …) move across modules; re-importing a name into runner fixes from-import callers but not setattr patches, which rebind runner's globals.
